anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, continuous convex arc extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base with a moderate radius of curvature.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio; distal tip is rounded and lacks extreme attenuation.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Prominent obtuse angle at the transition point between the melon's descending slope and the rostrum's dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Fine, linear, light-colored scratches (consistent with rake marks) visible on the dorsal melon; small dark punctate markings scattered across the lateral mid-flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Broad, high-contrast white-to-light-grey lateral sweep originating posterior to the eye and extending posteriodorsally, creating a sharp boundary with the dark dorsal cape.
